title: Career Roadmap · Building Maintenance Technician
summary: A Building Maintenance Technician inspects, maintains and repairs building systems and facilities, including plumbing, electrical fixtures, doors, HVAC equipment and basic civil components, within their training and authorization.

blocks.text: Primary pathway
Core work
Preventive maintenance • Fault reporting • Plumbing repairs • Basic carpentry and painting • Equipment checks • Work orders • Safety compliance.

blocks.label: Recommended
blocks.text: Class 10 with Mathematics and Science for technical ITI routes.

blocks.text: Science in Classes 11–12 is useful but not always mandatory.

blocks.label: Stage 1 — Foundation
blocks.text: Workplace safety, tools, measurements, maintenance records and fault reporting.

blocks.label: Stage 2 — Core skills
blocks.text: Plumbing basics, fixtures, doors, locks, minor repairs and building inspections.

blocks.label: Stage 3 — Advanced skills
blocks.text: Preventive maintenance, pumps, HVAC basics, electrical fault reporting, energy efficiency and work-order systems.

blocks.label: Stage 4 — Career preparation
blocks.text: Supervised maintenance rounds, fault logs, practical projects and apprenticeship applications.

blocks.label: Project ideas
blocks.text: Create a preventive-maintenance checklist • Assemble a demonstration plumbing fixture • Inspect and document common building faults • Prepare a maintenance schedule for a small facility.

blocks.label: Safety boundary
blocks.text: Electrical, HVAC, fire-safety and other regulated systems must be serviced only within the worker’s training, authorization and applicable rules.

blocks.label: Government / public sector
blocks.text: Public building maintenance departments, railway facilities and public-sector campuses.

blocks.label: Private sector
blocks.text: Hospitals, hotels, malls, residential complexes, IT parks, facility-management companies and commercial buildings.

blocks.label: Ideal training areas
blocks.text: Preventive maintenance • Plumbing • HVAC support • Building inspections • Maintenance documentation.

blocks.label: Technical skills
blocks.text: Fault diagnosis, preventive maintenance, basic plumbing, minor carpentry, surface repairs, inspection, record-keeping and workplace safety.

blocks.label: Tools / technologies
blocks.text: Hand tools, multimeter for authorized electrical work, pressure gauges, maintenance checklists, work-order software and building-management systems.
